extraction_hazards: Boilerplate dominates the file: disclaimer, nav bar, step-therapy paragraph (appears twice, in Billing/Coding and in Program Exceptions), definitions 'No guideline specific definitions apply.'.
The Position Statement is two lines; a heading-based parser must not mistake the long Description 'Summary and Analysis of Evidence' for criteria.
Update log shows 'investigational status maintained' repeated annually (useful as a stability signal).

Step-therapy exemption paragraph appears in BILLING/CODING as well as PROGRAM EXCEPTIONS, even though ductoscopy has no step-therapy requirement.
